newsitem.title: TURKEY: Rebel violence kills 35 in southeast Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Rebel violence kills 35 in southeast Turkey.

text.p: A total of 35 people, five of them members of the security forces, have been killed in separate rebel Kurdish incidents in southeast Turkey in the past two days, security officials said on Saturday.

They said security forces killed 26 members of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) near Kigi town in Bingol province on Friday night in a clash which continued into early Saturday. Five members of the security forces were also killed.
In another clash, security forces killed four PKK militants who were trying to cross into Turkey near Sirnak province from Iraq on Friday, they said.
More than 21,000 people have died in the PKK's struggle for independence or autonomy for Kurds in eastern and southeastern Turkey since 1984.
